THIS IS OUR HEART

Many stories.
One hope.

We are Apostles Church of Christ Dubai — a community gathered around the hope we find in Jesus.

Our mission is to preach the Gospel of Jesus to the nations and to heal the broken-hearted. Through biblical teaching, worship and prayer, we share messages that strengthen faith and inspire lives.

Where do I go when I arrive?

Use the address and directions above. If you need help when you arrive, call the church on +971 52 437 3611.

What time is the next service?

Our regular gatherings are Sunday and Thursday, 8:00–11:00 PM, and Saturday, 3:00–6:00 AM. All times are Dubai time (GST / UTC+4). Check church announcements for special-event changes.

Can I join from outside Dubai?

Yes. Visit our Live page, or follow our official YouTube and Facebook pages for available broadcasts and recordings.
